en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Mansour, from Hareyz, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
And he<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘Abundant laughter dissolves the Religion just as the water dissolves the salt’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Mansur from Hariz from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
He has also said, ‘Much laughing melts one’s religion just as water melts salt.’”
